claims.text: TOOLS exposes memory_put, memory_get and memory_history with journal or read effects and closed input schemas.
_put forwards to units.put with a registry Command carrying the actor and op_id, and _history and _get delegate to units.
VALIDATORS binds memory.put and memory.retire to domain validators and FOLDS binds the memory namespace at order 30.

decision.rule: Change here when memory tool schemas, handler routing, validators or the memory fold needs to change.
decision.failure: A memory tool reaches the domain with a wrong actor, or the memory fold stops receiving agent.born events.

questions.q: Where are the memory tool input schemas and handlers registered?
Where should I change how memory_put builds its registry Command?
